verdict.rationale: React is itself a first-party developer library, and its docs cover building against official packages. These include react-dom/client APIs (createRoot, hydrateRoot with options like onUncaughtError and identifierPrefix), server rendering via react-dom/server, React Native for mobile, TypeScript typings, and the official React Compiler Babel plugin. An llms.txt index of the docs is published for AI-assisted consumption. Missing for 10: no AI- or agent-specific SDK, no JavaScript-free language bindings, no independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality for AI-native workflows.
